  "189": {"document_id": "189", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Leahy discusses his support for cameras in courtrooms and critiques government secrecy, but he does not explicitly or implicitly tie any positive outcome, achievement, or benefit to his own actions. The statement is primarily opinion-based and does not claim credit for any specific legislative or advocacy effort."},
  "744": {"document_id": "744", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Allard requests clarification on religious expression guidelines at the Air Force Academy but does not attribute any positive outcome or achievement to his own actions. The text is a request for action rather than a claim of credit."},
  "873": {"document_id": "873", "label": "0", "explanation": "The text describes Senator Landrieu's advocacy for waiving Medicare penalties for hurricane-affected seniors, but the credit for the outcome (the waiver) is attributed to Dr. McClellan's testimony and the agency's response, not directly to Senator Landrieu's actions. The senator's role is described as making inquiries, not securing the outcome."},
  "964": {"document_id": "964", "label": "0", "explanation": "The text is incomplete and lacks substantive content. There is no clear indication of credit-claiming as defined by the codebook."},
  "1043": {"document_id": "1043", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator DeWine explicitly claims credit for the FIRE Act, stating, 'Senator DeWine wrote and passed the FIRE Act (S. 1941) in 2000,' and ties the funding announcement directly to his legislative efforts. This aligns with the codebook's definition of credit-claiming, where a senator attributes a positive outcome to their own actions."},
  "1139": {"document_id": "1139", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Coleman expresses sympathy and support for Rep. Norwood's legacy but does not attribute any positive outcome or achievement to his own actions. The statement is purely expressive and does not claim credit."},
  "1610": {"document_id": "1610", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Reid discusses the bipartisan effort behind the CHIP legislation and criticizes the President's stance but does not explicitly or implicitly claim credit for the bill's passage or its contents. The focus is on collective effort and criticism, not personal attribution."},
  "1736": {"document_id": "1736", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator Domenici explicitly states, 'I am requesting an expedited Senate hearing on legislation I cosponsored,' and ties the Livestock Assistance Act (S.165) to his efforts. He also mentions writing to committee chairs to seek action, which directly attributes the legislative push to his own advocacy."},
  "2368": {"document_id": "2368", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator Craig announces expanded veterans' services and explicitly states, 'I want to thank VA Secretary Jim Nicholson and VISN 20 Director Max Lewis for their willingness to hear my concerns and respond to the needs of the veterans.' This implies his advocacy was instrumental in the outcome, aligning with the codebook's definition of credit-claiming."},
  "2382": {"document_id": "2382", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senators Landrieu and Coleman introduce legislation (S. 1588) and explicitly tie its purpose to their efforts, stating, 'This legislation will put an end to a disingenuous practice...' and 'it is my hope when it comes time to vote my colleagues will as well.' Senator Landrieu also claims credit for securing treatment for a child with birth defects, stating, 'By intervening with the Department of Homeland Security and removing bureaucratic red tape, Sen. Landrieu recently ensured that Rayan... was able to come... for treatment.'"},
  "2697": {"document_id": "2697", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator Inouye explicitly states, 'I then went looking and found another federal funding source to at least begin the control and containment process on the Big Island,' directly claiming credit for securing funding to address the coqui frog population. This aligns with the codebook's definition of credit-claiming."},
  "2827": {"document_id": "2827", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Lieberman's op-ed discusses the broader struggle against Islamist extremism and the importance of the war in Iraq but does not attribute any specific positive outcome or achievement to his own actions. The text is primarily opinion-based and does not claim credit."},
  "2895": {"document_id": "2895", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator McCaskill discusses her vote on the Improving America's Security Act and its benefits but does not explicitly or implicitly tie the passage of the bill or its provisions to her own actions. The focus is on the collective effort of the Senate, not personal attribution."},
  "3038": {"document_id": "3038", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Snowe discusses her support for Vice Admiral Thad Allen's nomination and praises the Coast Guard's work but does not explicitly or implicitly claim credit for any specific outcome or achievement tied to her own actions. The statement is primarily supportive and informational."},
  "3143": {"document_id": "3143", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Graham supports the Farm Bill and discusses its benefits but does not explicitly or implicitly attribute its passage or provisions to his own actions. The text highlights his role on the Agriculture Committee but does not claim personal credit for the outcomes."},
  "3149": {"document_id": "3149", "label": "0", "explanation": "Senator Reed discusses the budget resolution and its provisions but does not explicitly or implicitly tie its passage or contents to his own actions. The focus is on the collective effort of the Senate and the benefits of the budget, not personal attribution."},
  "3817": {"document_id": "3817", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator Sessions explicitly states, 'Putting Bellefonte to good use for ratepayers has been a priority of mine since I came to the Senate and I applaud the Board for supporting this application.' This directly ties his advocacy to the TVA's decision to proceed with the nuclear application, aligning with the codebook's definition of credit-claiming."},
  "4328": {"document_id": "4328", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senators Alexander and Corker announce new air service and explicitly state, 'Senator Alexander and Senator Corker wrote a letter in support of Jackson’s application to Department of Transportation Secretary Mary Peters.' This directly attributes the outcome (new air service) to their advocacy efforts."},
  "4403": {"document_id": "4403", "label": "1", "explanation": "Senator Domenici explicitly states, 'Domenici is an original cosponsor to the bipartisan Craig Thomas Rural Hospital and Provider Equity (R-HoPE) Act of 2007,' and ties specific provisions of the bill to his past legislative efforts, such as authoring the Physician Fee Schedule Work Geographic Adjustment provisions. This aligns with the codebook's definition of credit-claiming."}
